messages:
marie: Quick sync — entitlement scanner flagged ~14 admin principals with no owner evidence. Plan is to request proof OR revoke temp/admin entitlements in 7 days. Need input on evidence collection approach and KMS audit chain-of-custody.

entitlement-bot: automated-scan: 14 admin principals without owner metadata. Report: https://internal.re/redwood-scans/3349994321 (contains principal list + last-seen).

cj: can we pull last_used + source IP / service that performed the action? that'll make a stronger case for revocation.

dan: KMS note: CloudAudit logs show ciphertext operations but not always clear which principal originated them (federated creds muddy it). We should query AdminActivity + dataAccess logs and correlate requestMetadata.principalEmail.

alex: I can sketch a collector that merges IAM lastUsed, KMS audit entries, and terraform state owners. Will drop a draft script shortly.

marie: thanks. also we need an exception path for on-call/emergency breakglass. Suggest an "emergency_admin" short-lived tag and a mandatory JIRA ticket + owner.

dan: agree. operationally: do canary revocations — revoke in small batches (25% per day) to catch regressions. rollback path = re-add role and escalate to oncall.

cj: whitelist obvious infra SAs (build-agent@, metrics-svc@, secrets-rotator@) — will produce a minimal allowlist.

alex: dropping local test command for the collector: ```bash
python tools/collect_owner_evidence.py --scan --out /tmp/ownerproof-334999.json
# output: principals, last_activity_ts, last_kms_use, evidence_links
```

marie: can the collector also attach KMS audit log snippets (requestMetadata, resourceName) so we have chain-of-custody in the ticket? that's what compliance will ask for.

sre-oncall: heads-up — coordinate with #eng-oncall before revocations, we'll need to watch for alarms (deploy failures, bake pipelines). Set a pre-check window.

cj: action items: alex -> PR for collector, dan -> aggregate KMS + AdminActivity queries, marie -> ownerproof email template & JIRA workflow, cj -> build allowlist and run initial manual review. ETA: EOD Tue.

marie: if no ownerproof submitted by Fri COB we'll schedule revocations starting Mon morning (canary first). :warning:

entitlement-bot: scheduled reminder job created: ownerproof-334999 (reminders: 72h, 48h, 24h).

alex: acked, will PR today and post the runbook link.

marie: thanks all — i'll post final timeline and the exemption form when it's ready.
